Case reference: 2012020003.CaseDesc: Kelly Rideout was reported missing to Chilliwack RCMP on August 28, 2011.  She is believed to have lived a high risk life style and her disappearance is suspicious.  Police believe that Miss Rideout was the victim of foul play.

Case reference: 2014005735.CaseDesc: On December 24, 1998, Rostyslav Korolko was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Rostyslav was living with his brother and he had told him that he was going to look for work.

Case reference: 2014001029.CaseDesc: On February 11, 1992, the body of this man was discovered on a beach in the vicinity of Hesquiat, located on the west coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia. He had sustained a previous injury to his right knee, which had resulted in arthritis, and he was likely to have originated from the United States.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Knee, Compression fracture of the right proximal tibia, accompanied by arthritis

Case reference: 2019012891.CaseDesc: Dean Brett Todd was last seen by his brother, around Easter time in 2000, near First Memorial Services Kamloops (formerly Schoening Funeral Home) on Tranquille Road in Kamloops, British Columbia. Dean had been invited to dinner, but did not show up. Dean is known to travel between Kamloops and Edmonton, Alberta.

Mark: Nose, Bump on arch of nose

Case reference: 2012020025.CaseDesc: At about 8:15 pm on May 3, 1983, 16 year old Shelley-Anne Bacsu left a friend’s house in the Sunset Trailer Park to walk the 7 km to her home. Her route took her west on Highway 16 through Hinton, then north on Highway 40. Witnesses saw Shelley-Anne walking westbound along the shoulder of Highway 16 carrying her school books; she was not hitch-hiking. Shelley-Anne was last seen in the area of what was then the western edge of town. A dark colored van was seen in the area around the time Shelley-Anne was walking home, some reports were that it was stopped at the side of the road near where she was last seen. An extensive search for the van and/or its occupants was not successful. Several days after Shelley-Anne was last seen, some of her belongings were found near the Athabasca River not far from the outskirts of Hinton.

Case reference: 2014004626.CaseDesc: In March of 1975, Barry “Rocky” Fiddler was reported missing by his family when he failed to return home.  It was learned that he was last seen in July of 1975 at a Powwow at the Thunderchild First Nation, Saskatchewan, which is approximately 1.5 hours from Meadow Lake, Saskatchewan.  Investigation and searches have failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2012020028.CaseDesc: Chantelle Bushie was reported missing by her family on September 14, 2009. She has not been heard from since December 2007. Chantelle was known to lead a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014002017.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1997, Marc Dionne was seen for the last time as he was leaving the Harley Pub in the Cap-de-la-Madeleine area of Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Marc was seen entering into a small white vehicle as the passenger. Marc was reported missing on the next day and there has been no news from him since.

Case reference: 2024006090.CaseDesc: Beverly Musick was seen for the last time in the area of the Seneca Casino in Niagara Falls, New York, USA on June 8, 2004.  The next morning, her personal belongings were located on Luna Island, NY. At the time of her disappearance, Beverly was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2023048947.CaseDesc: Autumn Dillon was last seen in September of 2023 in Lloydminster, Saskatchewan.

Case reference: 2018059144.CaseDesc: On October 9, 2018, Johnathan Braithwaite was seen for the last time as he was leaving the CIBC bank located on 45 King Street, in St. Catharines, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Johnathan was despondent.

Scar: Torso (Front), Scar from two gunshot wounds

Case reference: 2025021022.CaseDesc: Patrick Chum was last seen in October 2024, in Cochrane, Ontario.  He is known to frequent North Bay, Cochrane and Moose Factory, Ontario.

Tattoo: Left Calf, Feather and text "TANIKA ALEENA"

Case reference: 2014001952.CaseDesc: On September 19, 1980, James Neckoway and a friend departed Bird, Manitoba by canoe for the purpose of hunting and fishing. Their plan was to travel down the Limestone River, followed by the Nelson River. The canoe in which the men were travelling and the body of his friend were recovered on September 23. James has not been located and is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2012020176.CaseDesc: This adult male was found in Vancouver rooming house.

Case reference: 2021000139.CaseDesc: On January 1st, 2021, Zachery Lefave was last seen around 12:30 a.m., talking on a cellular phone while walking on Highway # 334 in the Plymouth region of Yarmouth County, Nova Scotia. Zachery had left a New Year’s Eve party that was being held in the area.

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2010000198.CaseDesc: Timothy Mason left his residence in Welland, Ontario, on September 14, 2009, at approximately 8:30 am.  Timothy was known to be an avid walker, frequenting trails and off-road areas, and suffered from heart problems.

Hair: Black, Grey, Short, Salt and Pepper

Case reference: 2014001464.CaseDesc: On the evening of August 16, 1989, Vincent Greene entered a wooded area behind his residence on Red Head Road, in Saint John, New Brunswick, to search for the family dog. The dog returned shortly after he had left, but Vincent never returned. An extensive ground search was conducted with negative results. Anyone with information is urged to contact the Saint John Police Force.

Glasses: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Steel rimmed
Jewelry: Gold, Wedding Ring, Lines on both sides

Case reference: 2014040212.CaseDesc: On October 24, 1991, Terry Patrick was seen for the last time at a motel in Pueblo, Colorado, USA. Terry was scheduled to go on a hunting trip with his friend on November 4, 1991, but never showed up.

Case reference: 2016030725.CaseDesc: Bryan Twan was reported missing in Quesnel, British Columbia, on June 7, 2016.  Bryan was last seen near Quesnel's West Park Mall and has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Denim, Light Blue, Yellow Drilling Rig Logo
Tattoo: Right Arm, BEV Heart and Unicorn

Case reference: 2014004904.CaseDesc: On the evening of April 5, 2007, Woon-Young Lee was seen for the last time at the West Park Health Centre in Toronto, Ontario.  When nurses came to Woon-Young's room the next day, she was gone.

Case reference: 2014003860.CaseDesc: Carl Charles Raun was reported missing on July 28 1975. He had sustained a spinal fusion, necessitating the use of a brace. There is a possibility that Carl's disappearance may be the result of foul play, however this has not yet been confirmed.

Case reference: 2005005699.CaseDesc: On June 22, 1991, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from the Niagara River between Horseshoe Falls and the "Maid of the Mist" boat docks. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 113 lbs, however this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Teeth: Several amalgam fillings in his teeth and multiple posterior teeth in his upper and lower jaw were lost/removed prior to death.

Case reference: 2014004779.CaseDesc: On May 3, 2006, David Robillard left a cultural camp with the intention of walking back to his home community of Black Lake, Saskatchewan. His whereabouts remain unknown.

Deformity: Right Leg, Walks with a limp

Case reference: 2014004257.CaseDesc: On March 24, 2003, Paul David Garcia was reported missing by his family in Chilliwack, British Columbia. Mr. Garcia left home in March 1997 leaving his vehicle and personal effects behind.

Case reference: 2014003528.CaseDesc: Kate Huyghe was last seen in Killam, Alberta on February 21, 1976.

Boots: Leather, Black, winter boot with suede fur tops
Jewelry: Metal, Gold, family ring with colored stone

Case reference: 2014005006.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2007, Sun Jin, her husband Joon Han, and their daughter Il Han were seen for the last time at a school in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2007005499.CaseDesc: Lindsey Nicholls was 14 years old when she disappeared in 1993. She left the group home where she was living in the Comox Valley, BC at about 10:30 a.m. after having an argument with her foster mother. She was last seen walking away from the residence to visit some friends in Courtenay. She left all of her belongings and treasures in her room; she did not seem to be planning to run away.

Case reference: 2014004569.CaseDesc: On August 1, 1966, Philomene (Tiger) Lemay was socialising at a local bar in Slave Lake, Alberta.  She was last seen in an inebriated state.  Philomene may have departed in the early evening with one or two men, possibly of American nationality.

Case reference: 2016068414.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1965, this unidentified male was found on the shore of Lake Ontario just east of the harbour pier in Oshawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 160 lbs, however, this may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present and he was not circumcised.

Teeth: Decayed teeth; gold inlay and prosthesis in his upper dentition; lower dentition had an amalgam filling
Shoes: Leather, Veritough, one left shoe; size 7
Scar: Right Upper Arm, circular puckered scar 1" in diameter on the anterior right underarm

Case reference: 2024008441.CaseDesc: Tara Moran was last seen in Merritt, British Columbia, on  February 8, 2024. She was engaged in a high-risk lifestyle. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Tattoo: Right Forearm, Heart shape, inner forearm

Case reference: 2014004801.CaseDesc: Beant Singh Khosa was last seen in Punjab, India on April 15th, 2006.  He travelled to India to attend his father's funeral and never returned.  It is rumored he has returned to Canada, however, his family and friends have not heard from him.

Case reference: 2014004517.CaseDesc: Edmee (Eva) Mitchell, 83 years old, went missing on August 20, 2004. Mrs. Mitchell was last seen at her rural residence near Kelly Lake, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2019010899.CaseDesc: Cynthia Parisian was last seen on the afternoon of February 17, 2019 at the Home Depot located at 845 Leila Avenue in Winnipeg, Manitoba. At the time of her disappearance, Cynthia was living a high-risk lifestyle.

Backpack: Pink, Blue leggings and pink pyjamas within
Pants: Black, With pockets with zip closure
Shoes: Timberland brand high heeled dress shoes

Case reference: 2012020090.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1993, a human foot and running shoe were discovered along the North Saskatchewan River, east of La Colle Falls and approximately 1 km west of the Saskatchewan River Forks Lookout, in the vicinity of Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. The foot was examined by the University of Saskatchewan Department of Archaeology. It was determined to be that of a robust male, size 10 shoe, big boned and athletic, likely between the ages of 30 and 60.

Case reference: 2014004917.CaseDesc: Robert Rudish and Lee Vrba arrived in Island Lake Manitoba on June 11, 1972, to fish. On June 17, RCMP received a report that a canoe was found overturned in the water. The canoe was soon identified as belonging to Lee. RCMP Investigators surmised the men went missing on either the Thursday or the Friday. The weather on both days was extreme, with high winds gusting to 30 mph, which caused the lake to be quite rough. Neither of the two men have been located and it is presumed both drowned.

Tattoo: tattoo on right or left forearm

Case reference: 2012020659.CaseDesc: On January 1, 2012, at approximately 1:30 a.m., Brandy Wesadquate was seen for the last time leaving a house party in the 900 block of Rae Street in Regina, Saskatchewan. Since then, Brandy has not had any contact with her family or friends.

Jacket: White, Black, Zippered; Adidas brand, blue or black stripes down the sleeves

Case reference: 2019053661.CaseDesc:
On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2006018099.CaseDesc: On January 4, 1994, David Ernest Rowbotham was last seen in the Belleville/Trenton Ontario area.

Case reference: 2014004496.CaseDesc: Peter Cortner was last seen on May 20, 2004. He was reported missing by his apartment manager where he resided in Downtown Vancouver. He had left all his belongings behind in his apartment suite and disappeared without notice.

Case reference: 2010001399.CaseDesc: On October 28, 2009, Trevor Andrews was seen for the last time when he left a friend's house in a residential area of London, Ontario, intending to catch a bus to go home. He never returned home to his father's apartment. It cannot be confirmed that he got on the bus. Trevor is known to be very sociable. He would be noticed because of his energetic behaviour. His absence and not calling home is out of character.

Case reference: 2014005033.CaseDesc: On April 28, 2000, at approximately 9:45 a.m., Kim Mezo was seen for the last time as she left the Branson Hospital in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004230.CaseDesc: Raymond "Ray" Kohout, a nurse, husband and father of three from Salmon Arm, British Columbia has been missing since April 29, 2002. He was last seen at approximately 4:30 p.m. riding a blue mountain bike on the Trans-Canada Highway between Salmon Arm and Canoe. On September 11, 2002, his bike was recovered between Salmon Arm and Sicamous, British Columbia. Raymond has not been seen or heard from since.

Jewelry: ring on the left ring finger
Sweater: Blue, Sweatshirt with “Selkirk College” on the front

Case reference: 2006010399.CaseDesc: William Halverson was last seen getting into a canoe at Bald Indian Bay in Lake of the Woods. He failed to arrive at his destination of Pine Portage Bay.

Case reference: 2016061151.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2014, a male was recovered from a reservoir behind Energy Ottawa, building #511 at 4 Booth Street, Ottawa. His appendix and gallbladder are present. It is believed that he had been in the water for a few days to a few months.

Hair: Brown, Medium length; balding and face stuble
Teeth: Extensive amount of dental work including root canal, crowns, posts and composite resin fillings.
Other: Red, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 2 disposable lighters
cigarettes in a white opaque plastic container
a hand drawn map of the Richmond Rd/Churchill Ave area, drawn on a torn off cover of a notepad
folding knife with built in nail file and opener on a ring
3 keys (SM "ILCO" key, Curtis "SC1" & Oscar "WR3" house keys)

Case reference: 2015020897.CaseDesc: In April of 2015, Delmer Paul Bonnetrouge was seen for the last time in Fort Providence, Northwest Territories. He was reported missing by his family.

Case reference: 2018054176.CaseDesc: On February 15, 1992, at approximately 10:00pm, Adu Frimpong was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014003432.CaseDesc: On August 3, 1979, June Johnson was driven by a friend to the Marlboro Hotel in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. We have not had any communication or sighting of June since that time.

Case reference: 2024014838.CaseDesc: Chance Kay left a motel in Gravenhurst, Ontario, on March 28, 2024. He left on foot into a wooded/swampy area.  Chance had made some comments prior to leaving and he may have been feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2020006482.CaseDesc: On January 11, 1990, Emabit Yafru travelled from Ethiopia to Toronto, Ontario. On January 25, 1990, her husband came to Toronto and could not locate her. During the time of her disappearance, Emabit was five months pregnant.

Case reference: 2020006473.CaseDesc: On April 22, 1967, at approximately 6:00pm, Roy Debone was last seen by his landlord in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005491.CaseDesc: On August 9, 2010, Michael Blakney was seen for the last time on a forest trail in the Scoudouc area of New Brunswick.

Deformity: Left Leg, Walks with a limp

Case reference: 2022043376.CaseDesc: On August 17, 2022, Angela Alexis was seen for the last time by a family member as she was leaving a residence on the Alexis Nakota Sioux Nation in Alberta. A few days prior to her disappearance, Angela spent a few days socializing with family and friends.

Case reference: 2014002595.CaseDesc: On November 15, 1997, John Grabluk was seen for the last time at the Scarborough Postal Union Office in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, John had taken a leave of absence.

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2014004730.CaseDesc: Geoffrey MacGibbon was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. In 1978, Geoffrey and his family relocated from Quebec to Toronto, Ontario. He has a history of mental health issues and has been in care in both Canada and the United States.

Scar: Front Of Neck, Tracheostomy scar on throat

Case reference: 2012020661.CaseDesc: Darlene Anderson was last seen leaving the Hantleman Building at the Royal University Hospital in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, at 8.00 p.m. on November 6, 2006.

Case reference: 2005002499.CaseDesc: On March 23, 1987, a black male was found on the shoreline of the Holly Bay Lodge (Lot 8, Con. 12, Dover Township) in Mitchell's Bay of Lake St. Clair, Wallaceburg. He may have been a smoker. He is believed to have been dead for approximately 8 months.

Money: coins, most recent 1985, distributed after March
Shoes: Blue, Grey, running shoes "Winner" brand, size 8 with velcro fasteners
Socks: Cotton, White, red and blue stripes at the top
Other: May have suffered from lower back pain

Case reference: 2014005152.CaseDesc: Anker Ljunggren was a farm hand who worked in Yellow Grass, SK. Anker was last seen in October, 1935, by his wife. He was working in Craik or Craven, SK but was heading north to find more work and was never seen or heard from again.

Case reference: 2014006465.CaseDesc: On January 18, 2014, Sofi Ma was seen for the last time with her father, Moses Ma, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002689.CaseDesc: Karel Szabo was last heard from in April or May of 1985, when he sent his mother, who lived in Czechoslovakia, a postcard from Los Angeles, California. Karel had written about his travels to Las Vegas and San Francisco. In November 1984, Karel had informed his family that he was going to Barrie, Ontario, to get a trucking job; when in fact he travelled to the United States.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Jaw, Lower right side jaw broken in 1982.
Scar: Waist, Dime sized surgical scar near the bellybutton.

Case reference: 2012020011.CaseDesc: Daniel Richard McCallum was living in the Lillooet, BC area up until October 2008.  When his family hadn't heard from him for some time, they reported him missing. There are unconfirmed reports that he may have moved away, but police have been unable to determine his whereabouts. His disappearance is considered suspicious.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, scorpio sign with "Dan" written inside

Case reference: 2018071052.CaseDesc: On July 11, 1998, the remains of a male individual were discovered on Sulphur Mountain in Banff National Park. There is dental work present, including multiple fillings. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 6 months and 5 years.

Case reference: 2007002299.CaseDesc: Michelle Bigras last spoke to her mother on October 11, 1985. At the time she was planning to hitchhike to Warkworth Institution, located near Warkworth, Ontario, to visit her boyfriend. She never arrived.

Scar: Eyes, 2 small scars on left eyebrow

Case reference: 2014003046.CaseDesc: Yu Lowe was last seen on February 15, 1984 when he left his home in Vancouver, British Columbia. Mr. Lowe said he was going to the movies and never came back.

Case reference: 2014003023.CaseDesc: Joseph Roussel was last seen on July 11, 1977 while climbing Mount Edith Cavell in Jasper National Park, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2020007343.CaseDesc: Marie Lyons had been living with her aunt after she had fled from her abusive husband. On April 12, 1971, Marie was last seen when her husband picked her up from her aunt’s residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Shoes: Brown, Laced; Low cut with laces

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2016061381.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1970 a Caucasian male was found in the ravine just north of Beechwood Ave. The ravine was located 300 yards south of the Leaside Bridge and approximately 100 yards east of the Don River.

Other: Rifle - Winchester Model 94 30-30 calibre, with a black and white rifle case

Case reference: 2014005158.CaseDesc: Frederick Lagrelle was last seen on April 12, 1997 in the area of the Sunchild and O’Chiese First Nations in Alberta. It is possible he was seen in Rocky Mountain House, Alberta days after. He was known to walk with a cane and wear a leg/knee brace. Frederick was described by family as having an intellectual disability as a result of a past accident.

Case reference: 2020007348.CaseDesc: On April 25, 1971, Liliam Alvarado was seen for the last time as she left her hotel room in Toronto, Ontario. Liliam left the hotel without her belongings.

Case reference: 2012020096.CaseDesc: On September 17, 2008, Kevin Michel was with two other people at Usinne Lake, near Creighton, Saskatchewan, harvesting rice. Witnesses state Kevin walked away from their camp for reasons unknown. Extensive ground, air and water searches were conducted in the area but failed to locate Kevin.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, "Kevin heart bombers" (text) or "Kevin (heart symbol) bombers"

Case reference: 2017062421.CaseDesc: Matthew Wiinikainen was seen for the last time on March 30, 1995 in Gaspé, Quebec. Matthew was in detention at the Youth Center “Unité La Rade”, located in Gaspé hospital area, Quebec. He escaped around 11:00 p.m. during the change of the guard.

Case reference: 2022048901.CaseDesc: On May 11, 2021, at approximately 7:33 a.m., Madison Roy-Boudreau was seen for the last time when she was picked up in a vehicle driven by a man at the corner of Assaff and Grange Streets in Bathurst, New Brunswick. Madison has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005589.CaseDesc: On May 1, 1971, Lillian Giroux was seen for the last time when she was left with relatives in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014002435.CaseDesc: On June 30, 1978, Mary Click was seen for the last time as she left her home in Madison, Wisconsin. Mary had crossed the American and Canadian border at Pigeon River and intending to hitch hike to Banff, Alberta. Some of her personal belongings were discovered in Thunder Bay, Ontario on July 1, 1978 and Raith, Ontario on August 1, 1978.

Case reference: 2014003163.CaseDesc: John Timothy McCarthy was last seen in Red Deer, Alberta on May 1, 1991. His van was located in Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario. However, it is not known whether he stayed in the region or went on to the United States.

Jewelry: Gold, Gold, Wedding ring with small diamonds

Case reference: 2020008538.CaseDesc: In mid-June 1976, Peter Vollar was last seen by his landlord in Toronto, Ontario. Peter had advised he was heading to London, Ontario for two weeks to seek job opportunities. All of his personal belongings were left behind.

Case reference: 2014005293.CaseDesc: On the morning of January 20, 1999, Abdol Hossein was seen for the last time as he left his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Scar: Cheek, Welts all over his face and cheek

Case reference: 2021019974.CaseDesc: On May 18, 2021, Jason Lambert was reported missing by his family.  Jason was last seen on or about April 16, 2021, departing from a residence in Oliver, British Columbia.  Jason has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003615.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1970, John Claus and his friend were reported missing to the police after being late from a boat trip. A pilot later spotted a swamped boat on Cormorant Lake, Manitoba and notified the police. Despite patrols and searches, John was never found. His partner was later recovered and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Foul play is not suspected in this matter.

Case reference: 2024008011.CaseDesc: Mathieu Therrien-Meunier was last seen on February 16, 2024 in the vicinity of Mont Durocher in Sainte-Adèle, Quebec. Mathieu may be travelling on foot, by taxi or by public transport. He may be found in the Laurentians region, particularly in wooded areas. Mathieu's family and friends are concerned for his wellbeing and safety.

Tattoo: Middle Back, Unknown description and unknown location

Case reference: 2019002992.CaseDesc: On August 25, 2018, Anupama Nadagouda was seen for the last time with her daughter, Anvita Mulemane, in India.

Case reference: 2014004451.CaseDesc: On February 22, 1964, Marie Mike was seen for the last time leaving a residence on the Beardy's/Okemasis First Nation Reserve near Rosthern, Saskatchewan.

Case reference: 2014003978.CaseDesc: Ernest Robert Pfaff left home at approximately 8pm on December 31, 1973 to purchase a loaf of bread. He was driving a 1972 Ford Maverick, light blue in colour, with red pin stripes on the sides.

Coat: Grey, Three quarter length pile coat

Case reference: 2025030773.CaseDesc: John Edwards was last seen at around 16:00 on 11 June 2025, leaving St. Joseph's Villa in Dundas, Ontario. He was walking south on Milgrove Side Road, heading away from Highway 6 in Flamborough. The distance from this location to the villa is approximately 10.3 km. John has cognitive impairments resembling dementia and is considered vulnerable. Due to the unpredictability of his movements and the recent heatwave, the police are extremely concerned for his safety. There is currently no evidence of foul play, and the Hamilton Police Service is appealing to the public and businesses for CCTV and dash cam footage.

Case reference: 2012020048.CaseDesc: Kathleen Johnston was last seen in the downtown area of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, at approximately 2:15 p.m. on October 20 1953. After visiting her mother at her residence, Kathleen disembarked from a city transit bus to go to her place of work, the Gem Café in the city centre.

Case reference: 2012020045.CaseDesc: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is seeking the public's assistance in locating Shirley Ann Waquan. Shirley was last seen on July 1, 2007 in Fort McMurray, Alberta.

Case reference: 2021056970.CaseDesc: On November 12, 1998, the remains of an unidentified woman were recovered from North West Connoire in Newfoundland. The woman had a complete fusion of the proximal and intermediate phalanges of her right ring finger. This fusion would have rendered her joint completely immobilized.

Case reference: 2006021799.CaseDesc: Leo Payash, was last seen on July 01, 1957. He and his mother Cecilia Payash, were walking on Red Lake Road in Ontario, and neither has been seen since.

Deformity: Nose, Described as having a "hooked" nose

Case reference: 2025022621.CaseDesc: At 10:01 a.m., on May 2nd, 2025, Jack and Lilly Sullivan were reported missing from their rural home on Gairloch Road, in Lansdowne, Nova Scotia. Jack and Lilly’s mother reported the children had last been seen that morning at approximately 7:00 a.m. - 7:30 a.m., and were noticed missing from the house at approximately 9:40 a.m. Extensive search initiatives began immediately utilizing RCMP, GSAR, Air Services, Police Dog Services and drones but have yielded negative results thus far.

Case reference: 2021003909.CaseDesc: On April 6, 2018, Rita Squalli and Maria Squalli were last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Rita and Maria were taken by their father under false pretences, and it is believed that the girls are being kept overseas.

Case reference: 2014006013.CaseDesc: Bruce Bradley Clarke is a nomadic individual who has traveled extensively throughout Canada, the United States, Mexico, South America, and Europe. Due to his opposition towards government and preference for anonymity, Bruce adopted numerous aliases.  Despite his unconventional lifestyle, he maintained consistent communication with his family, regularly calling or writing letters. The last time Bruce was in contact with his family was in June 1974. At that time, he was residing in a trailer on the outskirts of Tucson, Arizona, and he was employed by a landscaping company.

Case reference: 2014002718.CaseDesc: Wayne Robinson was last seen on October 8, 1985, running away from his school in God's Lake, Manitoba. It is unclear what prompted Wayne to leave school during the recess period. An extensive air, water and land search was conducted with no success.

Case reference: 2014006219.CaseDesc: On the night of the 17 to 18 August 2013, Benoit Germain was seen for the last time while he was attending a truck show in Baie-du-Febvre, Quebec. His car was found abandoned a few days later on a trail to a wooded area north of La Tuque, Quebec. Benoit has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2020011626.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1989, Ioan Sandea was seen for the last time leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004610.CaseDesc: On June 7, 1967, Absolom Halkett and his colleague, James Brady, were dropped off by plane at Foster Lake, SK, which is located 120 miles north west of La Ronge, SK. The two were prospecting in the area. They were last heard from on a radio call to a nearby mine on June 8th. Extensive land, air and water searches of the area failed to locate any trace of the two men. Their camp was located but had been unused.

Case reference: 2014005087.CaseDesc: Patrick Power was last seen leaving his residence on May 15, 1973 in Grand Falls-Windsor, Newfoundland and Labrador.  Patrick was planning on going fishing at Andersons Pond, Newfoundland and Labrador but never returned home and was last seen carrying a knapsack and fishing rod.
